name: print-social-web-design-desktop-folders-title-slide-on-brown
title: Chocolate title slide with cream 'web design', cursor and three blue folders
whatItIs: A dark brown slide with a huge cream heavy sans 'web design', a pixel-outlined cursor at its end, a subline about 2025 designs and three blue folders labelled website, ui/ux and web design.
whatItMeans: Simple and consistent; a colour inversion of the social media title slide.
techniques: Invert the palette of a series template.
Use one cursor as an accent.
Keep a subline small and light.

vocabulary.definition: Swapping light and dark colours for a variant.
A slide that names a portfolio section.
